mapper.select: select substring(table_name, length('u_f_shipbatch_') + 1) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'sdsorder' and table_name like 'u_f_shipbatch_2%'
mapper.sql: id, shop_code, shipcode, ordercode, shipdate, actualshiptime, warehousecode, warehousename, carrier, logisticsno, freightamount, freightpaid, freightpaystatus, payuser, paytime, status, createuser, createtime, confirmuser, confirmtime, shipuser, shiptime, pickphotos, pickuser, picktime, logisticsuser, logisticstime, rejectuser, rejecttime, rejectreason, updatetime, remark

b.id, b.shop_code, b.shipcode, b.ordercode, b.shipdate, b.actualshiptime, b.warehousecode, b.warehousename, b.carrier, b.logisticsno, b.freightamount, b.freightpaid, b.freightpaystatus, b.payuser, b.paytime, b.status, b.createuser, b.createtime, b.confirmuser, b.confirmtime, b.shipuser, b.shiptime, b.pickphotos, b.pickuser, b.picktime, b.logisticsuser, b.logisticstime, b.rejectuser, b.rejecttime, b.rejectreason, b.updatetime, b.remark
mapper.select: select , cu.nick_name as create_user_name, (select coalesce(sum(d.qty), 0) from sdsorder.u_f_shipbatchdetail_${tableSuffix} d where d.shop_code = b.shop_code and d.shipcode = b.shipcode) as total_qty from sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} b left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = b.createuser where b.shop_code = #{shopCode} and b.shipcode = #{shipCode}
mapper.insert: insert into sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} (shop_code, shipcode, ordercode, shipdate, actualshiptime, warehousecode, warehousename, carrier, logisticsno, freightamount, freightpaid, freightpaystatus, status, createuser, createtime, remark) values (#{batch.shopCode}, #{batch.shipCode}, #{batch.orderCode}, #{batch.shipDate}, null, #{batch.warehouseCode}, #{batch.warehouseName}, #{batch.carrier}, #{batch.logisticsNo}, coalesce(#{batch.freightAmount}, 0), 0, '未支付', #{batch.status}, #{batch.createUser}, sysdate(), #{batch.remark})
mapper.update: update sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} set warehousecode = #{batch.warehouseCode}, warehousename = #{batch.warehouseName}, carrier = #{batch.carrier}, logisticsno = #{batch.logisticsNo}, freightamount = coalesce(#{batch.freightAmount}, 0), remark = #{batch.remark}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{batch.shopCode} and shipcode = #{batch.shipCode} and status = '待确认'

update sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} set status = '备货完成', pickphotos = #{photos}, pickuser = #{operator}, picktime = #{operateTime}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and shipcode = #{shipCode} and status = '已打印备货单'

update sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} set status = '已录入快递单号', logisticsno = coalesce(#{logisticsNo}, logisticsno), carrier = coalesce(#{carrier}, carrier), logisticsuser = #{operator}, logisticstime = #{operateTime}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and shipcode = #{shipCode} and status = '备货完成'

update sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} set status = '待确认', confirmuser = null, confirmtime = null, shipuser = null, shiptime = null, actualshiptime = null, pickphotos = null, pickuser = null, picktime = null, logisticsuser = null, logisticstime = null, rejectuser = #{operator}, rejecttime = #{operateTime}, rejectreason = #{reason}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and shipcode = #{shipCode} and status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.delete: delete from sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and shipcode = #{shipCode} and status = '待确认'
